sentences.text:
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

1. By way of present petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 0491/2016 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act at P.S. Jafrabad.
2. It is informed that respondent No.2 is not available today.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J FEBRUARY 15, 2024 ga
